program_overview.title: AI Tools Mastery Course
program_overview.tagline: Fluency in the tools that now run knowledge work: prompting done properly, image and video AI, AI coding assistants, and real automation with agents.
program_overview.description:
The AI tool landscape changed what a single professional can do in a day, but most people use a fraction of it and use that fraction badly. This live online course builds real fluency for adults and professionals: prompt engineering with ChatGPT and Claude that goes far past one-line questions, then the wider toolkit, image generation with Midjourney and Stable Diffusion, video and audio AI, AI research assistants and AI coding tools, then the payoff layer that separates power users from dabblers: workflow automation, connecting tools through their APIs, and building AI agents that carry out multi-step work. Because the tools change monthly, the course teaches durable judgment (how to evaluate, adopt and drop tools) alongside current specifics, and treats ethics, verification and responsible use as core skills, not a footnote. A finale month builds a real automation and sits the final exam.

The pace is honest: about four months of teaching at two live classes a week plus practice, with margin in hand. Problem sets, monthly mixed reviews, phase exams, and a final exam that decides the certificate with a free retest.
what_makes_this_different: Prompting taught to real depth, the skill most people fake
The full modern toolkit: text, image, video, research and coding AI
The power-user layer: automation, APIs and AI agents that do multi-step work
Durable judgment for a fast-moving field: how to evaluate and adopt tools, not just the current list
Verification and ethics as core skills: AI that helps, checked before it ships
Real assessment: weekly problem sets, monthly mixed reviews, phase exams and a final exam with a free retest

faqs.question: What does this AI tools course cover?
faqs.answer: Prompt engineering with ChatGPT and Claude first, then the wider toolkit, image generation with Midjourney and Stable Diffusion, video and audio AI, AI research assistants and AI coding tools, then the automation layer, workflow automation, connecting tools through APIs, and building AI agents for multi-step work, with tool-evaluation judgment, verification and responsible-use ethics throughout. A finale month builds a real automation and sits the final exam.

faqs.question: How long does this AI tools course take?
faqs.answer: About four months of teaching at 2 live classes a week plus practice, with margin in hand for a 5 to 6 month total. Three phases cover prompting, the wider toolkit, and automation with agents; the finale month builds a real automation and sits the final exam.

faqs.question: How am I assessed? Is the certificate just for attending?
faqs.answer: No. Problem sets follow every class with written feedback, monthly reviews deliberately mix new material with earlier topics, each phase ends with a cumulative exam, and the course ends with a final exam: a practical build plus written questions from the whole syllabus. Passing earns the certificate; falling short earns focused revision and a free retest.

faqs.question: The tools change every month, so will this course be out of date?
faqs.answer: The specific tools will keep changing; the skills will not. Prompting well, evaluating a new tool quickly, wiring automations and verifying AI output are durable, and this course teaches those alongside current specifics. You leave able to pick up the next new tool in an afternoon, which is the real skill.

faqs.question: Do I need to be technical to take this course?
faqs.answer: No. Most of the course needs no coding: prompting, image and video AI, research tools and no-code automation are all accessible. The automation phase touches simple API use, taught gently, and you can go as deep or as light there as your goals need. It is built for professionals of every background, not just developers.

faqs.question: Is this course suitable for teenagers?
faqs.answer: This is our adult (18+) AI tools course, because several tools it uses, including the general-purpose image and chat models, set their own terms and age limits at 18. Younger learners have a dedicated teens AI tools course built entirely around teen-appropriate, age-compliant tools, which is the honest place for them to start.

faqs.question: What are the fees?
faqs.answer: Group classes are ₹1,499 per month, with 2 live classes a week in batches capped at 10 learners. A mini batch of 3-4 learners is ₹2,999 per month, and personal 1-on-1 classes are ₹4,999 per month. International learners pay a price set for their own country, shown on this page in their local currency.
